turns.reply:
The merge conflicts in https://github.com/fischerq/ludumdare60/pull/15 are fixed: I merged `main` into its branch with a merge commit (no rebase) and pushed. In a headless phone-size browser, the maze level and the cabinet both rendered with no console errors.

Most conflicts kept both sides:
- **`design/master.md`:** the systems table now has the Art row and the two cabinet/screen layer rows. The art paragraph says both that Max makes the pixel art and that it's pixel art throughout with no real 3D. Both sets of decision-log lines are kept.
- **`making-of/manual-log.json`:** the "Teamed up with Max" entry is kept, and the PR #14 merge is logged only once.

`BootScene.js` was a real code clash, not just text. PR 15 doubled the maze tiles from 8 to 16 px and builds the maze from a tileset, while `main`'s cabinet layer draws the game picture at 8 px per tile. I kept the tileset and added the cabinet and joystick art. The picture on the cabinet's screen stays at the old 8 px arcade size and shows the new 16 px art at half size, so zooming out from the maze still lines up. The new 8 px setting is `screenTile` in `CABINET` in `src/config.js`. When the cabinet's maze flashes after you clear it, it's now just recoloured with the existing flash colour from PR 15, so it no longer needs a separate texture.

To test on the phone: play the maze level, then clear it to reach the cabinet. Check that the zoom-out doesn't jump and the joystick still works.

I didn't get fresh plan usage at the end of this turn; it was 2% of the 5-hour limit and 17% of the weekly limit at the start of the session.
